content.short: Gami Labs runs a professional DeFi vault platform for institutional allocators.
content.description: Gami Labs operates curated yield vaults aimed at institutional allocators, separating flagship strategies from more advanced ones so that risk appetite determines the product rather than the position size. It is among the larger curators on Robinhood Chain, whose tokenized equity collateral gives vault strategies a different underlying to work with than a purely crypto-native chain.
